title: Domain of Rhodes
capsule: The Domain of Rhodes was an autonomous Byzantine Greek lordship that emerged after the Fourth Crusade dismembered the Byzantine Empire in 1204. It was ruled by Leo Gabalas and his successor John, who styled themselves Caesar and lord of Rhodes and the Cyclades. It was eventually brought back under the Empire of Nicaea and later seized by the Genoese.
